entities.name: Arabidopsis RecA3
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q9ZUP2, annotated as DNA repair protein RecA homolog 3, mitochondrial.
Length is 430 aa; predicted molecular weight is 46.16 kDa and theoretical pI is 8.17.
N-terminal residues 1–35 are annotated as a mitochondrial transit peptide; mature chain begins at residue 36.
Pfam detects RecA_N at residues 61–325, Rad51 at 92–283, ATPase at 95–152, and RecA_C at 329–382.
Annotated activities include ATP binding, ATP-dependent DNA damage sensing, single-stranded DNA binding, DNA strand exchange, and DNA endonuclease activity.
Annotated processes include recombinational repair; homologous bacterial RecA proteins additionally support DNA recombination, DNA repair, and SOS response.

entities.name: Mitochondrial recombinational repair
observations: Arabidopsis RecA3 is annotated in recombinational repair and mitochondrial DNA repair/recombination functions.

entities.name: RecA ATPase domain
observations: The sequence contains a strong RecA_N/Rad51-family ATPase architecture, supporting ATP-dependent nucleoprotein filament formation and DNA strand exchange.
